problem: Can a deployable startup decision improve the field score before local lifetime labels exist? The previous independent N-CMAPSS outcome is now known, all comparisons in this protocol are development tests. Use one identical estimator across official bearing and engine, the same external PRONOSTIA/PHM08 streams and N-CMAPSS DS01. Consecutive source-held-out model predictions are for development only, independent service outcomes never select weights.
method: Move Breiman's stacked regression to grouped source data and online maintenance: ridge alpha 1 with source-only standardization plus forest(100, depth=6,seed=17), no model-specific feature engineering. Split whole source units into at most four folds by SHA256('life-stack-v1/<unit-id>') order, assign cyclically. For each held-out source unit obtain OOF predictions. Estimate one convex mixture weight w on ridge, remainder on forest, with every device equal total sample weight. Report fixed 0, 0.5 and 1 and source-only stacked w. If forecasts coincide choose 0.5.
feedback: When a field stream has legitimate separate failed reference units, allow five evenly spaced prior measurements per completed unit strictly after failure; recompute one regression coefficient, using the source OOF aggregate and observed reference-device aggregate each with equal total mass (full fitted deployable predictors on the field). Compare to keeping source-only w as well as fixed half. No local feedback to this arm on official validation; use same service IDs as integrated delivery and report those scores separately. For official-sourced streams use the official fit subset and real feature schema, raw bearing with established window conversion; engine use the source-derived input-restoration transformation on all five arms, fitted on each fold's training data before prediction. N-CMAPSS uses the frozen prior source/feedback/service split.
accept: Report each combined RMSE, worst-device RMSE, number of source and target fits, weights learned at startup and after each return, compare to fixed half and both components, source-only versus revised w, prior defaults and current relevant mature scores. Do not promote a family on a single favorable site. End the branch if any of the three metrology contexts fails a 1% gain or exceeds 1% worst-device tolerance vs the best fixed comparator. Unknown-source confirmation remains required.
